# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VOLUME_DIVERGENCE

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Gaps formed on below-average volume frequently revert to the prior close (gap fill) due to lack of institutional participation. We capture this mean-reversion edge by fading the gap open with volume and RSI filters, targeting the first 30 minutes of the session when gap formation is most pronounced and VIX > 20 elevates volatility-driven gap probability.

## Mechanism

**Entry:**  
- Gap up > 0.2% and volume on gap bar < 0.5 * average volume of prior 20 bars → go short at bar close  
- Gap down < -0.2% and volume on gap bar < 0.5 * average volume of prior 20 bars → go long at bar close  
- Additional RSI filter: RSI > 60 for gap-up shorts, RSI < 40 for gap-down longs  
- Regime filter: Only first 30 minutes (09:30-10:00 ET) and VIX > 20  

**Exit:**  
- Initial stop: Chart-stop at opposite gap edge (short stop above gap high, long stop below gap low)  
- TP1: Gap fill (price returns to prior close)  
- Runner: Trail using premium-stop of 0.5% of price after TP1 hit

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (based on 50% risk cap and typical entry premium)
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed strategy uses 16-month lookback (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) for initial ideation; high overfit risk due to multiple parameter thresholds (gap %, volume ratio, RSI levels, time window, VIX threshold) without out-of-sample validation
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed yet)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no validation against real OPRA bid/ask/slippage on top 3 J days)
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: Persistent gap continuation (trend day) causing stop-out at gap edge opposite direction  
   - Max drawdown: Consecutive losing gap days in low-VIX regime where gaps rarely fill  
   - Blow-up scenario: Volatility expansion during gap formation leading to overshoot beyond stop before reversal  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days = X% of P&L, X must be measured post-backtest)
